text: News & Events Speakers Ben Fletcher Ben Fletcher Codasip Organisation Codasip LinkedIn Biography Ben Fletcher has been involved in SoC development for over 25 years. He has worked in design, verification, software, and more recently Architecture. He has worked for Codasip for 2 years, and is currently working on performance models and architectures of out-of-order cores, along with SoC developments (all featuring CHERI technology).
